courses.synopsis: Kinematics and Kinetics of particles. Work, energy, power, momentum and impulse. Kinematics and Kinetics of rigid bodies in plane motion. Analysis of elementary dynamic systems – dynamic systems elements: mechanical, electrical, fluid and thermal. Newton’s laws of motion. D’Alembert principles and Legrange’s equations. Particle dynamics in non-inertial frame of reference.
